angle: speed-and-UX-first: fast compares, fast app, honest UI, share
thesis: Optimises the shopper's clock. First unstall the event loop. Then serve known fragrance pairs from one owned KB card RPC with a Haiku verdict (whole response p95 under 10 s), keep cold compares under 25 s by moving every fill into an off-process worker, paint per-product cards over SSE, and cut client floors. The honest UI (remote-flagged three chips, no fake numbers, as-of prices, unknown never invented), per-channel share and a two-question card ship as OTAs after approval. Deferred: verdict cache, auth throttles, judge loop, live web_search, operator capture.
